# 3D models used by src/tools/goal3d.py

- `Xbot.glb`: the "X Bot" mannequin from Adobe Mixamo (with idle/run/walk clips), as shipped in the three.js r160 examples
  (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160/examples/models/gltf). Mixamo characters and animations are royalty-free
  for personal, commercial and non-profit projects (Adobe Mixamo FAQ); we only publish rendered video, never the model file.
- Three.js r160 (MIT) is in `src/vendor/three/`.
